en: A black-and-white postcard depicting a mountain restaurant or bar called 'S.F.C. Bar Ristorante' surrounded by snow, with dramatic snow-covered peaks in the background. The establishment has large windows and signage visible on the building. There is Italian text on the building as well as handwritten or printed text at the bottom of the postcard. The scene is alpine and picturesque, indicative of a high-altitude location.
